title: Standing adjustment body
description: The Courts remove counted jobs from an agent's qualifying standing (register row DK1730; credits.md CR-14; spec-delta S1431) when collusion or a finding says they should not have counted. `ref` is the record that is the reason (a ruling, a finding or an upheld report). Each contract must be a counted job of the agent and is removed once. The weights come off the agent's qualifying jobs, which the bond floor, the starter grant's rest and Town Hall eligibility read; a tier already granted is not demoted by this record and no credit moves. Chain: none (prev is null).
